newsitem.title: UK: Compco buys UK retail, hotel complex.
newsitem.headline: Compco buys UK retail, hotel complex.

text.p: Compco Holdings PLC said on Wednesday it had conditionally agreed to buy a retail and hotel development in Sheffield, northern England, from P&O Properties Ltd for 6.025 million stg.

Compco said its purchase of the Grosvenor House development, comprised of 26 ground-floor retail units, an 84-space car park and the 103-room Grosvenor House Hotel, would be completed on or around March 21.
It said it would pay 2.7 million in cash for the devlopment and fund the rest by the issue of 2,309,750 new ordinary Compco shares of 20 pence each.
